name: Giant Octopus
otherStatistics: Perception +4, Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. No languages.
appearance: A massive octopus with a mottled burgundy mantle and eight muscular arms lined with pale suction cups.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), Chapter 12, Monsters, printed p. 134.
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. Out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
Underwater Camouflage. Gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while underwater.
Water Breathing. The octopus only breathes underwater.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 15-ft. reach against one target. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. While that grapple lasts, the octopus cannot use Tentacles on another target.
Ink Cloud. When underwater, fill a 20-ft. radius around the octopus with ink. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, or until a significant current clears it. After releasing the ink, the octopus can Dash as a bonus action. Recharge after a short or long rest.
sections.At the table: The Tentacles hit applies the grapple and restraint. The DC is for an escape attempt. The grappled target can use its action to escape with a successful DC 16 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. Ink Cloud obscures vision in its area.
